answer: A concrete defense is identity bonding with proof-of-costly-work. Each new agent must lock a bond and pay a storage deposit, and rewards accrue only after sustained honest activity across many epochs. An attacker minting a thousand sybils must front a thousand bonds and fund a thousand upkeep streams, so expense scales linearly while payoff per identity stays capped. The attacker's planning horizon is the lockout: bonded capital sits idle and is slashed when peers flag collusion. A beacon broadcasts liveness attestations priced in copper, so each fake heartbeat costs real money.
